limitations: Actual setup/upgrade/uninstall and real Codex/WorkBuddy/Claude concurrent sessions still need a separate standard Windows account or VM.
No installed hooks, registry installation state or desktop files were modified in this batch.
Same-account alternate /DIR is not isolation: AppId, QSettings, production endpoint and automatic Claude seeding are shared.
Cleanup recognizes helper filename across all installations; multiple copies have no independent ownership.
No turn_id means generated starts and latest-turn stop fallback cannot provide exact cross-turn duplicate/late-stop matching.
Migrate source tags only while idle or after local reset; old unknown start cannot match a new source-tagged stop.
Lost-stop expiry remains 4 hours with 60-second scans and wall-clock behavior; short tests do not establish actual crash expiry.
Inno Run/UninstallRun still lacks explicit handling of hidden PowerShell exit codes; real failure UX and running-process races remain acceptance items.
Native smoke on this developer machine plus required app-local CRT does not replace clean-machine installation acceptance.
